objective: Fix the two small installer defects the Windows re-reviews found: the profile-line regex matching indented comments and curly single quotes in profile paths.
scope: (1) Line ~218: anchor the mise activation regex so indented commented lines do not match, using ^\s*[^#\s] before the rest of the pattern, and check the BUN_INSTALL regex the same way. Prove it with a bun one-liner over: "(& mise activate pwsh)" (match), "  # (& mise activate pwsh)" (no match), "\t#mise activate pwsh" (no match), "# (& mise activate pwsh)" (no match).
(2) ConvertTo-SingleQuoted (~line 95): also double the curly single quotes U+2018, U+2019, U+201A and U+201B, which PowerShell treats as quote characters.
constraints: Work only in that worktree; edit only install/windows-install.ps1; make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
When done, run mise run fmt:check and report; stop.

criteria.text: The regex probe gives the four expected results and ConvertTo-SingleQuoted doubles all five single-quote characters
